thread:
Maya Chen: Heads up — thinking about adding a 'safety ratecap' gating layer for automatic fallback so we avoid noisy rollbacks during transient error spikes. Sketch below.

Samir Patel: Love the idea. How's this different from sampling + cooldown?

Maya Chen: Ratecap would temp-limit percent of traffic eligible for autofallback based on error budget depletion, not just random sampling. So we can shrink blast radius as errors rise.

Zara Lee: +1. Does this interact with per-route quotas? We don't want to bypass quota checks.

Maya Chen: Good call. Plan is same check order: quota -> ratecap gating -> decision engine. Ratecap config example:

```yaml
ratecap:
  window_secs: 60
  max_autofallback_pct: 5
  scale_by_error_budget: true
  min_pct: 0.5
  cooldown_secs: 300
```

Samir Patel: Quick Q: where does telemetry show this? Need rollout dashboard to show gated pct, stuck counts, and operator overrides.

Levi Ng: Ops-bot ran a sim earlier, posted results: "sim_id: rc-2026-03-21-7" — showed reduced unnecessary rollbacks by ~40% in noisy networks.

DevX Bot: /sim results attached: https://internal/sims/rc-2026-03-21-7

Zara Lee: For auditability we should emit an event when gating blocks fallback with enough context: route, decision_id, current_pct, reason.

Maya Chen: Agree. Also capture the "effective_pct" at the time — that'll help playback in the audit tool.

Samir Patel: Operator override UX: allow a sticky manual-enable that bypasses gating for N minutes with a justification field. Audit log must store user, reason, TTL.

Zara Lee: And add a 'dry-run' toggle for the ratecap so ops can preview what would have been gated in the last hour.

Maya Chen: I'll add to the proto. I'll also open a tiny console mock for the rollout team. Anyone want to pair on the mock before I commit?

Levi Ng: I can at 3pm. Ping me.

Samir Patel: I'll review the telemetry schema. One ask: add a signal "gating_level" with raw_error_budget pct so we can correlate.

Maya Chen: Thanks — filing a follow-up PR with YAML + mock link + sim results. Will tag y'all.

Ops-Bot: Deploy check passed for draft policy. /ok
